author: Rufi Thorpe
keyCast: Elle Fanning, Michelle Pfeiffer, Nick Offerman, Nicole Kidman, Greg Kinnear
notes: David E. Kelley is producing this Apple TV+ series adaptation in collaboration with A24, featuring an exceptional ensemble cast: Elle Fanning as Margo, Michelle Pfeiffer as her mother, Nick Offerman as her father, Nicole Kidman as a mediator, and Greg Kinnear as the mother's new boyfriend. The stellar casting and prestige producers indicate high expectations for this contemporary family drama. Kelley's track record with character-driven ensemble pieces suggests this will receive significant promotional support. The novel explores family dynamics and personal reinvention, themes that translate well to serialized television.
